contract_plain_english: On a probability space (Ω, Σ, P), the passage considers a real-valued random variable X. Its expectation, also called its mean and written E X, is identified in footnote 1 with the Lebesgue integral of X. Its variance is the expectation of the square of its deviation from its mean: Var(X) = E[(X − E X)²]. The book omits expectation brackets, with nonlinear operations such as squaring binding before expectation. The passage does not explicitly state integrability, square-integrability, finiteness, or detailed measurability assumptions [PDF page 1; printed page 5, Section 1.1 opening, displayed formula, and footnotes 1–2].
